name: jira-sprint-reporting-agent
description: Pulls a completed sprint, its retrospective, and the upcoming sprint from Jira and Confluence, and assembles two artifacts: a comprehensive internal Sprint Review Analysis (Confluence page) and a distilled, brand-styled Management Report (PDF). Read-only on Jira except a human-gated t-shirt-size write-back; writes Confluence pages only. First capability of the ReformAI Jira Agent.

reads.jira: sprints, issues, epics, t-shirt size (customfield_10225), sprint field (customfield_10020); count-based (no story points)
reads.confluence: Sprint N - Retro page (structured page, never a whiteboard)

writes.jira: READ-ONLY except customfield_10225 (T-Shirt Size) write-back - human chooses the value, agent transcribes; never estimates. Cannot move issues between/out of sprints (Agile board API not available).
writes.confluence: creates/updates pages in space RAPD (Sprint N - Review Analysis, Sprint N - Planning)

autonomy.prohibited: sprint membership changes, deletes, schema/permission changes, accepting/closing work

env_vars.atlassian_auth: Atlassian API token (email + token) or OAuth 2.0 3LO; runtime currently driven via the Atlassian MCP
